name: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITI’s
benefit:
1.	The scholarship of ₹200/- per month will be given to the student of Scheduled Caste in each academic year.
2.	Under the scheme, ₹15/- per month as tuition fee will be reimbursed.
**Note 01:** No scholarship will be given to failed students.
**Note 02:** The scholarship will be given in two installments in each academic year. The first installment (50% amount) will be given after taking admissio
_eligibility_text:
1. The Scholarship will be given to all Scheduled Castes students who are studying in Government ITI&#39;s situated in Haryana State.
   1. The students should belong to the Scheduled Castes of Haryana.
   1. The student should be a resident of Haryana State.

**Note:** The students taking benefits of this scheme will not be eligible to get benefits under any other State/Central Scheme.
